description: This file declares the WifiManagerWPS class which provides an API for WiFi Protected Setup (WPS) operations such as initiating pairing, canceling pairing, saving SSID, clearing SSID, and retrieving pairing info within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: WifiManagerWPS
classes.description: A class implementing WPS-related functionalities for WiFi management in the plugin namespace, providing methods for initiating and canceling pairing, saving and clearing SSID, and retrieving pairing information.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts the WPS pairing process with given parameters, returning status code.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing WPS pairing process.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves the specified SSID to the device.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently paired network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently paired.
